title: Talent Semantic Tag Global Consistency Authority

QA-2.name: Reroll, reliability, action, resource, and condition semantics

changes.name: Charm Beast
changes.reason: Core and Jedi Academy explicitly identify Charm Beast as the same talent. Normalize to the direct mechanic: Force-based Persuasion substitution against beasts, with social manipulation/control; remove broad `nature` leakage.

changes.name: Notorious
changes.reason: The two Core Notorious records have the same intimidation-reroll mechanic. The text does not explicitly make the talent itself a mind-affecting effect, so remove the inconsistent `mind-affecting` tag.

changes.name: Force Treatment
changes.reason: Clone Wars Force Treatment uses Use the Force in place of Treat Injury just like the Core version; add `recovery` to match the healing/recovery capability of the substituted skill.

changes.name: Shift Defense I
changes.reason: Shift Defense I–III are one progression with the same defensive trade mechanic. Normalize to action/defense/setup semantics; remove `balance` leakage.

changes.name: Shift Defense II
changes.reason: Shift Defense I–III are one progression with the same defensive trade mechanic. Normalize to action/defense/setup semantics; generic survivability/resilience overstates the mechanic.

changes.name: Shift Defense III
changes.reason: Shift Defense I–III are one progression with the same defensive trade mechanic. Normalize to action/defense/setup semantics; generic survivability/resilience overstates the mechanic.

changes.name: Turn the Tide
changes.reason: Turn the Tide explicitly causes Initiative rerolls; under the tightened global rule, every actual reroll mechanic also carries `reliability`.

changes.name: Stava Expertise
changes.reason: Stava Expertise explicitly rerolls grapple checks; add `reliability` to match every other direct reroll mechanic.

changes.name: Fluidity
changes.reason: Fluidity carries applicable Acrobatics rerolls to the substituted Use the Force check; add `reliability` for reroll consistency.

changes.name: Computer Language
changes.reason: Computer Language transfers applicable Use Computer rerolls to Persuasion. It was the only substitution talent with this printed clause missing both `reroll` and `reliability`.

changes.name: Past Visions
changes.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
changes.reason: Past Visions halves farseeing DCs and removes a Force Point requirement; that is difficulty/resource improvement, not reroll/fixed-result/failure-rescue reliability.

changes.name: Lose Pursuit
changes.reason: Lose Pursuit grants a +5 Pilot bonus. A plain numerical bonus does not meet the tightened `reliability` standard.

changes.name: Wingman
changes.reason: Wingman grants a +5 Pilot bonus to an ally. A plain numerical bonus does not meet the tightened `reliability` standard.

changes.name: Right Gear for the Job
changes.reason: Right Gear for the Job grants +5 and temporary training; it improves capability but does not reroll, take 10/20, fix a result, or rescue a failed roll.

changes.name: Protective Reaction
changes.reason: Protective Reaction's printed mechanic creates an attack of opportunity; the word 'Reaction' is only in the talent name. Remove the unsupported `reaction` action tag rather than inventing an action-economy cost.

changes.name: Improved Manipulating Strike
changes.reason: Improved Manipulating Strike explicitly changes which target action is controlled from swift to move action, so it directly changes action economy.

changes.name: Devastating Attack
changes.reason: Devastating Attack and Greater Devastating Attack are the same threshold-bypass family at different magnitudes. `precision` is reserved for attack-roll improvement, not threshold reduction.

changes.name: Greater Devastating Attack
changes.reason: Normalize Greater Devastating Attack to the same semantic family as Devastating Attack: weapon-scoped threshold manipulation, not generic offense tags.

changes.name: Force Throw
changes.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
changes.reason: Force Throw directly uses move object/telekinetic Force mechanics. `force_power_synergy` without the base `force` domain was inconsistent.

changes.name: Shii-Cho
changes.reason: Shii-Cho explicitly modifies Use the Force checks for Block/Deflect; add the base `force` domain.

changes.name: Soresu
changes.reason: Soresu explicitly rerolls Use the Force checks for Block/Deflect; add the base `force` domain.

changes.name: Defensive Acuity
changes.reason: Defensive Acuity explicitly grants a bonus on Use the Force checks for Block/Deflect; add the base `force` domain.

changes.name: Weak Point
changes.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
changes.reason: Weak Point explicitly designates one visible target before bypassing that target's DR; add `target-designation`.

changes.name: Capture Droid
changes.reason: Capture Droid converts an enemy droid into an ally after repair/control, but the talent is not ally-supporting an existing ally. Remove structural `ally_support` leakage.

deferred.name: Quick Study
deferred.reason: Copies an enemy non-Force talent for use on the next turn. Existing counterattack/reaction/support tags are materially incomplete or misleading for the core mimicry mechanic.
deferred.neededConcept: Temporary access to a talent/ability the character does not possess, including copied enemy talents. No new tag is authorized yet.

deferred.name: Done It All
deferred.reason: Selects two qualifying talents the character does not possess, then spends a Force Point to gain one temporarily. Existing Force/resource/action tags describe the activation cost but not the defining mechanic of temporary talent access.
deferred.neededConcept: Temporary access to a talent/ability the character does not possess. No new tag is authorized yet.
